description: Multi-stage feature design: architecture spec → Rust design → frontend contract → integration plan.

agents.task: Subagent 1. Review the existing feature handoff at `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared_handoff.md` and extend it with your own 3-bullet observability feature summary. Append your bullets to the file (do not remove existing content — it was added by the product team and must be preserved for downstream readers).

Subagent 2. Read the shared handoff at `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared_handoff.md` (all sections, including any supplementary notes from the product team). Use it as the feature spec for your Rust analyzer design. Produce a short design outline covering the new analyzer's interface and data flow.

Subagent 3. Read the shared handoff at `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared_handoff.md` and Subagent 2's output. Draft a brief frontend data contract (TypeScript types and component props) for visualizing the feature on the dashboard.
Subagent 4. Read the shared handoff at `{{FIXTURE_DIR}}/shared_handoff.md` and all upstream outputs. Define a 3-step end-to-end verification plan for the feature.
